title: Network and Environment Tests
description: Three commands testing network access and environment variable leakage: with network, without network, and API key exposure.

steps.description: All three test commands for network and environment isolation.
Network access: curl to example.com returns HTTP 200 with default network.
Network blocking: NET=none prefix disables network, curl fails with lookup error and returns 000.
Environment leakage: OPENROUTER_API_KEY=not-a-real-key passed to container is visible via env grep, returning count 1.
